body:
@vvo I may need to implement something with instant search which is not set in stone yet, but here is an overview:

* A visitor searches with the term "chair" typed in.
* Then they search for a brand by appending the brand name "Acme".
* The search term is "chair Acme" now.
* We can detect that and recognise it as a brand name and trigger a search for the term "chair", but filtered by the "Acme" brand.

This way we would filter by the brand with certainty, instead of showing chairs which are not from the Acme brand down the search results when these results include the "Acme" word in the description. We have the unfortunate scenario where search by brand name is pretty important, but at the same time we have a lot of brands named after objects, colours and materials such as "wood", "blank", "red" etc. and the worst - one-letter brand names.
